verses.text: Ixlajwi chi', ix cheklaj jun yechel t'a satcha'anh te niwan yelk'ochi. Ay jun ix ix, ha k'u ayoch spichulok ix, haxo k'e'en uj ayoch sk'anhok yok ix, aypaxk'e lajchawe' k'e'en k'anal scorona'ok ix.
Yab'ix ix, ayxokot sya'il yune' ix. Ix el wal yaw ix, yujto snib'ej ix skolchaji.
Hanhejtona' t'a jun rato chi', ay junxo yechel ix cheklaj t'a satcha'anh chi'. Ay jun niwan dragón chakchak. Uke' sjolom, lajunhe' sch'a'ak. Haxo t'a junjun sjolom chi', ayk'e scorona.

Kenxonhej manh nanhalok k'e'en k'anal ix slokkot yet' snhe t'a satcha'anh chi', ix syumanem t'a sat lu'um. Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och linhan t'a yichanh ix yab'ix chi', yik schib'at jun unin chi' yalani, ayik ol ajok.
Haxo ix alji jun yune' ix chi', winak unin. Haton jun chi' ol ak'an mandar masanil nación, ichato ha jun k'e'en k'okoch ol scha'a. Hato wal yalji, ix ik'jib'at t'a Dios b'aj ay sdespacho.
Haxo jun ix ix chi', ix b'at ix elelal t'a tzinan lu'um. Hata' ay jun lugar lista yaj yuj Dios. Mil 260 k'uhal ix ak'ji wa ix ta'.
Ix yamchajoch owal t'a satcha'anh. Ay jun sat ángel skuch Miguel yet' heb' yetángelal, ix yak' owal heb' yet' jun dragón chi'. Hanheja' jun dragón chi' yet' heb' yángel, ix yak'pax owal yet' heb'.
Palta maj yak'laj ganar jun dragón chi'. Yuj chi' manhxalaj slugar heb' ix ak'chaj t'a satcha'anh chi'.

Ichaton chi' ix aj syumchajkanel jun niwan dragón chi', haton jun yak'nakoch sb'a chanil t'a peka', haton winh diablo, winh Satanás. Haton winh tz'ak'an musansatil masanil anima ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal. Ha winh chi', ix yumjikanemta winh t'a yol yib'anhk'inal yet' heb' yángel.

Ixlajwi chi', ix wab'an yoch jun aw t'a satcha'anh. Te cha'anh ix yala': Ha tikne'ik ix cheklajel jun kolnab'il syak' ko Diosal. Scheklaj spoder to Yajal yaji. Ix cheklajpaxi to ha Cristo Ak'b'il Yopisio yuj, ha ix ch'oxaneli to ha' skuchb'an masanil. Yujto ha winh tz'ak'anoch t'a yib'anh heb' yikxo Dios, ix yumjikanel winh. Ha winh chi', t'a k'uhal t'ak'wal ix yak' sk'o'ol ko Diosal winh t'a spatik heb'.

Ha heb' chi', ix yak' techaj heb', yujto yujnhej heb' chamnak jun kalnel sb'i elnak schik'il. Ix yak' wal ganar heb', yujto tek'an ix yutej wal sb'a heb' yak'an testigo'al sb'a yuj. Manh jab'ok ix xiw heb' schami, yujto tek'tek' ix yutej sb'a heb'.

Yuj chi', ayokab' tzalajk'olal t'a satcha'anh yet' masanil heb' ayek' ta'. Palta te chuk heyik ha hex ayex ek' t'a sat lu'um yet' hex tzex b'eyek' t'a sat ha' mar. Yujto ix emk'och winh diablo b'aj ayex ek' chi'. Te yowal winh, yujto yojtak winh to kenxonhej tiempo ayek' winh.
Haxo yik ix yilan winh dragón chi' to ix yumjikankot heb' t'a yol yib'anhk'inal, ix b'at yak'lej yak'anoch yahelal t'a yib'anh jun ix ix aj yune' chi'.

Palta ix ak'ji'och sk'axil ix te niwak, lajan yet' sk'axil nok' t'iw. Yuj chi' ix b'at jenhenhok ix t'a slugar listaxo yaj t'a tzinan lu'um, yik max yamchaj ix yuj jun Chan sb'i chi'. Hata' ix ak'ji wa ix nanhal schanhil ab'il.
Haxo jun Chan sb'i ayoch t'a spatik ix chi', ay wal jun niwan ha' ix elta t'a yol sti', snib'ej ha jun ha' chi' tz'ek' leman ix.
Palta haxo lum lum ix kolwaj yet' ix. Ix jakwi jun niwan xab' t'a lu'um. Haxo ta' ix satkanem jun niwan ha' chi'.

Ichato chi' b'i'an, ix wach'kot yowal jun dragón chi' t'a ix. Yuj chi' ix b'at yak' owal yet' juntzanhxo heb' yinhtilal ix, haton heb' sk'anab'ajan tas syal scheknab'il Dios, heb' tek'an syutej yak'anoch spensar t'a slolonel Jesucristo.
Ixlajwi chi', ix aj tek'tek' jun dragón chi' t'a yarena'il sti' ha' mar.
